title: feat(costname): named equal-weight rule reproduces minkbest 8-tuple
science: MAJOR REVERSAL of the diamond no-go, not a probe cell: the diamond obstruction of #6684/#6692 turns out to be an artefact of the {1,2} cost alphabet. The named LOCAL-IN-WEIGHTS clause rho = 'cost 3 if w_v = w_w or w_v = 0, else cost 1' reproduces the displayed minkbest 8-tuple (3,1,3,1,1,3,1,1) exactly on the eight B_3 orbits, extends canonically to the ninth orbit B_4 grows ((3,3) on 48 directed edges) with rho(3,3)=3, and on B_4(0) (129 sites) it REVERSES the diamond order: t(3,0,0)=9, t(1,1,1)=5, 3*81=243 > 9*25=225, with t(4,0,0)=12. The arrival table is invariant under any (3,3) cost >= 3 and that bound is sharp (costs 1 or 2 change 24 arrival times). Uniqueness of rho is explicitly not claimed.
verdict_pair: none stated (no reverse/face verdicts in the diff; 'reverse' means reversing the diamond ordering)
